specificationName: Activity Template Flow via MCP Backend
summary: Activity templates MUST be retrieved exclusively through metabob-rpc-api via metabob-cli MCP. Direct file reading prohibited. Flow: Activity agent → TemplateServiceClient → MetabobCLI → MCP → metabob-cli → RPC API → SurrealDB.

components.currentBehavior: Attempts to load from MCP backend (metabob) first via TemplateServiceClient, falls back to embedded bootstrap templates if backend unavailable. Returns source='metabob' for successful backend loads, source='local' for bootstrap fallback.
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - Already correct. strictBackend mode enforces backend-only for non-bootstrap templates. Bootstrap templates (evolve-activity, manage-session-memory) allowed as cold-start fallback.
components.gap: NONE - Architecture compliant. No direct .metabob/activities/*.json file access.
keyMethods: load() - Lines 101-190: Tries TemplateServiceClient.getTemplate(), falls back to bootstrap
list() - Lines 204-298: Tries TemplateServiceClient.listTemplates(), falls back to bootstrap
save() - Lines 361-396: Saves via TemplateServiceClient.registerTemplate() to MCP backend

components.currentBehavior: Abstraction layer over MetabobCLI MCP tools. Provides typed methods matching TemplateService proto spec. Uses MetabobCLI.searchActivities() for search, MetabobCLI.getActivity() for retrieval, MetabobCLI.registerActivityTemplate() for registration.
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - Already correct architectural abstraction. Enforces MCP communication path.
components.gap: NONE - Properly delegates to MetabobCLI which calls MCP tools.
keyMethods: registerTemplate() - Lines 293-341: Calls MetabobCLI.registerActivityTemplate() with 30s timeout
listTemplates() - Lines 399-419: Uses searchTemplates() with empty query

components.currentBehavior: MCP tool wrapper. searchActivities() calls 'search_activities' MCP tool. getActivity() calls 'activity' MCP tool. registerActivityTemplate() calls 'metabob_register_activity_template' MCP tool. NO local file writes (removed at lines 803-813).
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - Already correct. MCP-only communication, no local file persistence.
components.gap: NONE - Architecture compliant. Local file write removed per architectural constraint.
keyMethods: searchActivities() - Lines 681-737: Calls MCP 'search_activities', returns summaries
getActivity() - Lines 750-786: Calls MCP 'activity' with activity_id, returns full template
registerActivityTemplate() - Lines 797-854: Converts to Metabob format, calls MCP 'metabob_register_activity_template'

components.currentBehavior: Has search_activities tool enabled (line 123). Uses activity templates for complex workflows, direct execution for simple tasks. Full tool access including read/write/bash/task delegation.
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - Already correct. Activity agent focuses on template selection and execution orchestration.
components.gap: NONE - Agent properly configured with search_activities tool.

components.currentBehavior: Manages impulse lifecycle and infers variables for activity execution requests. When user types %activity-name, Memory agent loads session impulses, infers variables from context, and calls activity() tool. Handles impulse_create, impulse_load, impulse_list tools.
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - Already correct. Memory agent focuses on impulse state management and variable inference from history.
components.gap: NONE - Separation of concerns enforced: Activity agent = template selection, Memory agent = impulse state + variable inference.

components.currentBehavior: Loads template via TemplateLoader.load(). For meta-templates, injects similar activity context via TemplateServiceClient.searchSimilarActivities() (lines 993-1070). Creates impulse with historical execution patterns.
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - Already correct. Uses TemplateLoader which enforces MCP backend flow.
components.gap: NONE - Activity tool properly delegates to TemplateLoader.

components.currentBehavior: Provides /v2/activities/templates endpoints: GET /templates (list with Thompson Sampling), GET /templates/{id} (get specific), POST /templates (create/variant), POST /executions (record results), POST /templates/{id}/metrics (update metrics from OpenCode).
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - Already correct. Provides backend API for template management.
components.gap: NONE - API endpoints functional and spec-compliant.
endpoints: GET /v2/activities/templates - Lines 72-131: List with Thompson Sampling
POST /v2/activities/templates - Lines 175-272: Create template or auto-variant
POST /v2/activities/executions - Lines 318-359: Record execution for learning
POST /v2/activities/templates/{id}/metrics - Lines 413-544: Update metrics from OpenCode

components.currentBehavior: Business logic for template management. Enforces surrealdb-primary-redis-cache spec: Write path → SurrealDB (primary) → Redis cache (TTL). Read path → Redis (hit) OR SurrealDB (miss) → populate Redis. Thompson Sampling uses Beta(alpha, beta) for variant selection.
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - Already correct. SurrealDB primary storage with Redis cache.

dataFlow.step7: RPC API → SurrealDB query (primary) OR Redis cache (hit)
dataFlow.step8: Response flows back: SurrealDB/Redis → RPC API → metabob-cli → MCP → MetabobCLI → TemplateServiceClient → TemplateLoader → Activity agent
dataFlow.templateRetrieval: For full template: MetabobCLI.getActivity() → MCP 'activity' tool → RPC API GET /v2/activities/templates/{id}
dataFlow.templateRegistration: TemplateLoader.save() → TemplateServiceClient.registerTemplate() → MetabobCLI.registerActivityTemplate() → MCP 'metabob_register_activity_template' → RPC API POST /v2/activities/templates → SurrealDB write + Redis cache

validationPoints.check: TemplateLoader.load() returns source='metabob' for backend templates

notes: Architecture separation enforced: Activity agent focuses on template selection, Memory agent manages impulse state and variable inference
MCP backend flow fully implemented: No direct file system access to .metabob/activities/*.json
Bootstrap templates (evolve-activity, manage-session-memory) have controlled fallback for cold-start scenarios
strictBackend mode available to enforce backend-only loading for production deployments
Thompson Sampling in RPC API enables continuous learning and variant selection
SurrealDB primary storage with Redis cache (TTL) ensures data durability and performance
